card.text: An A-type star 1.7 times the Sun's width on a seven-year, eccentric orbit around Achernar.

introduction.text: It comes within 2 au of Achernar at periastron; its disc spans 0.37 milliarcseconds, 1.70 solar radii, with 9,064 K at its surface.

color.title: Photosphere color
color.summary: The color of the star's light, dimmed toward the edge by a model atmosphere.
